name: Cyclone Arnab

moving.text: Moving inland, north-west, towards south Odisha and Chhattisgarh
moving.eta: Deep depression by this evening, depression by early Thursday

headline: Arnab crossed the coast near Yanam overnight. It's weaker now and moving inland, but heavy rain and flash floods are still likely today and tomorrow in coastal Andhra, south Odisha and east Telangana.

position.label: Landfall area: ~40 km SW of Yanam, ~60 km SW of Kakinada (IMD)

briefing.t: Crossed the coast near Yanam overnight (landfall began ~1:20 am). Now over land and weakening.
No deaths reported. Worst wind is over for the coast.
Kakinada: seawater flooding, Uppada coastal road washed away, trees and poles down.
Heaviest rain: 261.5 mm at Kannuripalem (Anakapalli). Visakhapatnam, Kakinada, Konaseema 200 mm+.
Next danger: flash floods in south Odisha (Malkangiri, Koraput, Rayagada, Ganjam, Gajapati) and coastal AP districts.
53–91 trains and 21+ flights cancelled. Check before you travel.

updates.x: Odisha: system moving towards Chhattisgarh. Flash-flood alert for Malkangiri, Koraput, Rayagada, Ganjam, Gajapati. 313 rescue teams deployed.
IMD: landfall complete, storm entirely over land. No loss of life reported in AP.
Kakinada police rescued 4 people from floodwater and 3 stranded at Anchorage Port godowns.
609 schools turned into relief centres in AP; 854 people sheltered by early Wednesday.
Weakened to a severe cyclonic storm: 110–120 km/h winds.
Kakinada: trees and power lines down. Visakhapatnam: fallen trees block Beach Road and Seethammadhara.
Landfall begins south of Yanam as a very severe cyclonic storm, 125–135 km/h, gusts 150.

mood.t: Relief on the coast: 'the worst is over', with no deaths reported.
Rescued workers in Kakinada thanked police teams for reaching them in time.
Worry now shifts inland: flash floods and landslides feared in south Odisha's hill districts.

districts.what: Landfall zone. Heavy rain, flooding, power cuts.

places.note: Seawater flooding; Uppada coastal road washed away; trees and poles down.
Fallen trees on Beach Road, Seethammadhara; 200 mm+ rain. GVMC toll-free 1800-425-0009.
Trees, poles down; some roads flooded.

districts.what: Storm's next stop. Very heavy rain, flash floods, gusts to 80 km/h.
Heavy to very heavy rain today and tomorrow.

places.note: No cyclone alert. Cloudy, light to moderate rain, gusty winds.

faq.q: Is the cyclone coming to Hyderabad?
faq.a: No. Hyderabad has no cyclone alert. Expect clouds, light to moderate rain and gusty winds. The heavy-rain alert is for Khammam, Kothagudem, Mulugu and Mahabubabad.

faq.q: Is the danger over on the coast?
faq.a: The strongest winds are over: the storm is on land and weakening. Flash floods and fallen lines are still a risk today. Stay indoors until officials say it's safe.
AP closed schools Oct 27–28 in 13 coastal districts (Anakapalli till Oct 29). Check your district's order for Oct 29.
53–91 trains and 21+ flights (Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam) were cancelled. Check IRCTC / your airline before leaving.
No restoration time announced yet. Report fallen lines or outages in coastal AP on 1912 (APEPDCL).

faq.q: My family is in a red district. How do I check on them?
faq.a: Call the district control room listed for their district. In AP you can also WhatsApp Mana Mitra on 9552300009 (send 'Hi').

safety: Stay indoors until officials say it's safe.
Keep away from the sea, rivers, canals and flooded roads.
Don't touch fallen lines or wet poles. Report on 1912 (AP).
Charge phones; keep a torch, water, medicines and documents in a plastic bag.
Never drive or walk through flood water.
Forward only what you can verify.
